# NEEDLE: Deterministic bead processing for headless coding CLI agents

## Quickstart (install to first closed bead)

curl -fsSL https://github.com/jedarden/NEEDLE/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
cd <your-repo> && needle init --backend bead-rs
bead init --prefix <name>
bead create --title "Add a CONTRIBUTING.md" --priority 2
needle doctor
needle run --agent claude --identifier alpha
needle status
tmux attach -t needle-claude-alpha
bead list --status closed

## Expected outcomes
- Install: binaries in ~/.local/bin (override with NEEDLE_INSTALL_PATH)
- init: creates .needle.yaml and ~/.config/needle/config.yaml
- bead init: creates .beads/ with beads.db (SQLite) and .beads/checkpoint/
- bead create: prints bead ID (e.g., abc123def)
- doctor: all PASS or WARN rows, exit code 0
- run: starts worker in tmux session, processes beads
- status: lists active workers and session names
- list --status closed: shows completed beads

## Failure modes (2026-08-29)
- No `bead` on PATH: install.sh failed or NEEDLE_INSTALL_PATH not on PATH → rerun install.sh
- `unknown adapter` (claude): agent CLI not installed or not on PATH → install agent CLI
- doctor FAIL rows: each names its fix (e.g., "set bead_cli.backend in .needle.yaml") → follow the fix
